title: AI Business Solutions Analyst
description:
AI Business Solutions Analyst – Canary Wharf /WFH – to £55,000 basic plus bonus to £62,000

Global client has an amazing opportunity for an AI Solutions Analyst with a Digital Business Analyst background and experience of building business applications rapidly using AI-assisted development, generating working code through AI tools, and then reviewing, refining, and delivering reliable solutions.

This is a superb opportunity for a Business Solutions Analyst with knowledge of AI solutions in a role that requires 2 days per week in the office (Tuesday and day of your choice), salary to £55,000, a 13% discretionary bonus% and an annual salary review to 10%

As an AI Business Solutions Analyst Digital you will be required to design and deliver practical applications and automations across Office 365, Power Platform, SharePoint, Power BI and Azure, working closely with stakeholders to turn business needs into working software and also to deliver AI initiatives from minimum viable products to production-ready tools. Code / low code (Vibe coding is preferred), agent assisted development is desirable as is building agents in Azure foundry. The role also promotes and deploys collaborative applications within the Office 365 tenancy, such as team workspaces, workflows and document sharing.

With 1-2 years experience in AI you will have the ability to build applications and automations by using AI tools to generate, refactor and debug code (ie:- Anti-Gravity, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and the AI capabilities within Power Platform and Azure AI Foundry, review and validate all AI-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability, turn plain-language business requirements into working prototypes quickly, then iterate with stakeholders to reach a production-ready solution. You will be aware of emerging AI and low-code technologies, assess their business impact and solve business problems with creative, practical solutions, work with business partners to draw out high-level requirements and capture needs in a structured, produce process flow diagrams and light documentation to support the business and hand-over, maintain knowledge of new Office 365 and AI features and evaluate them for business use, apply data governance, security, and compliance policies to everything built and collaborate with infrastructure engineers, digital business analysts, and governance teams to ensure solutions and AI agents are secure and compliant.

This role is commutable from London, Canary Wharf, home counties, Sussex, Hertfordshire, Essex, Surrey, Kent
